interpretation_limits: BoSS: The notice supplies no lower production-date bound and no exact manufacture year. Records must not be presented as 2012 machines.
BoSS: Do not infer dates for serials outside the four model-specific ranges or fill gaps by extrapolation.
BoSS: Upgrade completion labels concern the repair status. They do not change manufacture date or establish an exact year.
BoSS: The historical 2013 campaign and 27 October 2016 incident are event dates, not manufacturing dates.
Aichi: The manual's January 2018 edition, 2017 copyright and 2017 declaration date are not individual-machine manufacture dates.
Aichi: A blank plate diagram establishes a field and where to inspect; it does not date a particular unit.
Aichi: Do not generalize these plate/model facts to all older Aichi scissors, ANSI models or boom platforms.
Aichi: No authoritative general serial-to-year algorithm was located in the reviewed official public material. Exact year stays unresolved without an actual plate value or manufacturer record.

additional_reviewed_material.finding: Alternate official file also shows the manufacture-year plate field. Filename includes 2020, while inner edition still states January 2018; therefore filename/upload dates must not date units.

Official archived September 2011 manual gives model-specific design-change serial thresholds, but these are not calendar-year decoding rules. Its p.1 excludes X3 YMG 11001–11300 from that manual's operational applicability; this does not invalidate those serials in the separate historical notice.
additional_reviewed_material.status: Read through web tool; direct download returned HTML rather than PDF. No plate-year field from this manual relied upon.
